name: Barbell Shrug
heavyWhy: shrug: very heavy loads in a short range (Leo's call: ★)
setup: Bar in front, hands just outside your thighs. Stand tall.
Straps so your grip doesn't fail first.
form: Shrug straight up, hold 1 s.
Lower all the way down.
tempo: Up 1 s · Hold 1 s · Down 3 s

preferred.why: Heaviest-loading upper-trap lift; strength is specific to the lift trained.

name: Behind-the-Back Barbell Shrug
heavyWhy: shrug: very heavy loads in a short range (Leo's call: ★)
why: Bar behind you: shoulders pull up and slightly back.
setup: Bar behind your legs, hands shoulder width.
Straps if your grip fails first.
form: Shrug straight up to your ears, hold 1 s.
Lower all the way down.
tempo: Up 1 s · Hold 1 s · Down 3 s

name: Smith Machine Shrug
heavyWhy: shrug: very heavy loads in a short range (Leo's call: ★)
why: Heavy shrug without balancing the bar.
setup: Bar at mid-thigh, hands just outside your thighs.
Set the stops just above your knees.
form: Shrug straight up to your ears, hold 1 s.
Lower all the way down.
tempo: Up 1 s · Hold 1 s · Down 3 s

name: Smith Machine Behind-the-Back Shrug
aliases: Smith Machine Behind the Back Shrug
heavyWhy: shrug: very heavy loads in a short range (Leo's call: ★)
setup: Bar behind your legs at mid-thigh, hands shoulder width.
form: Shrug straight up to your ears, hold 1 s.
Lower all the way down.
tempo: Up 1 s · Hold 1 s · Down 3 s

name: Trap Bar Shrug
heavyWhy: shrug: very heavy loads in a short range (Leo's call: ★)
why: Heavy shrug, palms in, weight at your sides.
setup: Stand inside the trap bar, grab the handles, stand up tall.
Straps if your grip fails first.
form: Shrug straight up to your ears, hold 1 s.
Lower all the way down.
tempo: Up 1 s · Hold 1 s · Down 3 s

preferred.why: Weight at your sides lets you load heavy and shrug straight up.

name: Dumbbell Shrug
heavyWhy: shrug: very heavy loads in a short range (Leo's call: ★)
why: Shrug with the weight at your sides.
setup: Dumbbells at your sides, palms in. Stand tall.
form: Shrug straight up to your ears, hold 1 s.
Lower all the way down.
tips: Straps help once the dumbbells get heavy.
tempo: Up 1 s · Hold 1 s · Down 3 s

name: Cable Shrug
heavyWhy: shrug: very heavy loads in a short range (Leo's call: ★)
why: Shrug with tension at the bottom.
setup: Bar on a low pulley, stand close, arms straight.
form: Shrug straight up to your ears, hold 1 s.
Lower all the way down.
tempo: Up 1 s · Hold 1 s · Down 3 s

name: Machine Shrug
heavyWhy: shrug: very heavy loads in a short range (Leo's call: ★)
why: Heavy shrug, load on your shoulders, no grip needed.
setup: Stand in a standing calf machine, pads on your shoulders.
Arms relaxed at your sides.
form: Shrug straight up, hold 1 s.
Lower all the way down.
tempo: Up 1 s · Hold 1 s · Down 3 s

name: Plate-loaded Shrug
heavyWhy: shrug: very heavy loads in a short range (Leo's call: ★)
why: Heavy shrug with handles at your sides.
setup: Stand between the handles, grab them, stand up tall.
Straps if your grip fails first.
form: Shrug straight up to your ears, hold 1 s.
Lower all the way down.
tempo: Up 1 s · Hold 1 s · Down 3 s

name: Lateral/Shrug Hybrid
heavyWhy: shrug: very heavy loads in a short range (Leo's call: ★)
why: Heavy traps: small side raise plus a shrug.
setup: Heavy dumbbells at your sides. Straps if your grip fails first.
form: Raise your arms out a little while shrugging up to your ears.
Hold 1 s, lower slowly.
tips: Shoulders to ears matters, not arm height.
avoid: Turning it into a light side raise.
rangeOfMotion: Arms at your sides → small raise with a full shrug
tempo: Up 1 s · Hold 1 s · Down 3 s

name: Kelso Shrug
heavyWhy: shrug: very heavy loads in a short range (Leo's call: ★)
setup: Chest on the T-bar row pad, arms straight.
form: Squeeze your shoulder blades together, hold 1 s.
Let them go forward.
tips: Short move. Make the squeeze count.
tempo: Back 1 s · Hold 1 s · Forward 3 s

preferred.why: Locked elbows take the arms out and leave the middle traps.

name: Prone Dumbbell Kelso Shrug
heavyWhy: shrug: very heavy loads in a short range (Leo's call: ★)
why: Kelso shrug with dumbbells on an incline bench.
setup: Lie face down on an incline bench.
Arms hanging straight, palms facing each other.
form: Squeeze your shoulder blades together, hold 1 s.
Let them go forward.
avoid: Lifting your chest off the bench.
tempo: Back 1 s · Hold 1 s · Forward 3 s

name: Overhead Trap
why: Lower traps, which work hardest overhead.
setup: Cable on the lowest setting.
Stand 3–4 feet away.
form: Raise your arm in a big arc over your head.
Finish in a Y, slightly in front of your head, thumb up.
Hold 1 s, reach up high, lower slowly.
tips: Go light enough to reach the top every rep.
rangeOfMotion: Hand by your side → arm straight overhead
tempo: Up 1 s · Hold 1 s · Down 3 s

preferred.why: Arm overhead in a Y works the lower traps hardest.

name: Incline Dumbbell Y-Raise
why: Chest on a bench, arms up in a Y: lower traps.
setup: Lie face down on a low incline bench.
Light dumbbells, arms hanging, thumbs up.
form: Raise your arms up and forward into a Y, in line with your body.
Hold 1 s, lower slowly.
avoid: Lifting your chest off the bench.
rangeOfMotion: Arms hanging → arms in a Y
tempo: Up 1 s · Hold 1 s · Down 3 s

name: Scapular Pull-up
why: Pull your shoulders down while hanging: lower traps.
setup: Hang from a pull-up bar, arms straight.
form: Pull your shoulders down away from your ears, lifting your body a little. Hold 1 s.
Lower slowly back to a full hang.
tempo: Up 1 s · Hold 1 s · Down 3 s
